description: A Drupal module class defining a view field plugin for displaying boolean values with customizable formats and options.

classes.name: Boolean
classes.description: A handler to provide proper displays for booleans in Drupal views, supporting multiple output formats and customization.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the boolean field, including output type and custom labels.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up default formats based on output formats and custom labels.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the field, allowing users to select output format and custom labels.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the boolean value according to the selected format and options, handling reverse display if specified.
